chunks: God will say: 'This is the day when the truthful shall profit by their truthfulness. For them will be gardens with streams running by, where they will for ever abide. God will accept them, and they will be gratified in (obeying) Him. This will surely be happiness supreme.'

key_terms.الصَّادِقِينَ: The Truthful, those who are sincere in faith and action

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for the truthful on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Ma'idah?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited as the climax of Surah Al-Ma'idah, underscores the concept of 'Sidq' (truthfulness) not merely as honesty but as the alignment of one's inner state with divine reality, a key theme in Shia exegesis regarding the Ahl al-Bayt. It emphasizes the reciprocal nature of salvation, where God's pleasure precedes and enables the believer's contentment, marking the transition from the trials of this world to the eternal abode of Jannah.
